verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is fundamentally code/API-first: agents are plain Python objects that can be run anywhere (web frontend, terminal, voice, background queue) and the CLI/browser chat modes are explicitly built as thin wrappers over the same Agent API (Agent.to_cli_sync(), 'spin up a uvicorn server to chat with your agents from your browser'), implying no UI-only functionality exists outside the API. missing for 10: an explicit statement enumerating UI-exclusive features and confirming none exist, and independent/community confirmation that CLI or Logfire UI actions have no API gaps.
